purpose: Teach: 迷宮/生業/生身/ディテール/恐怖症/遺書/言い渡し/私事

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、長年迷宮入りしている事件を、警察、再捜査されますね
lines.en: So the department will be reopening this cold case that's been stalled for years, I understand.
lines.style: Measured, intellectually curious. Quiet confidence in the question. Leans into the specifics like fitting pieces together. No rush—methodical rhythm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、密造を生業とする者の追跡もされますね
lines.en: We'll also be tracking down anyone engaged in illegal operations connected to it.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Even tone, no flourish. Acknowledges the point without defensiveness. The clarity of someone used to laying out procedures.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、生身の証人を、警察、丁寧に保護されますね
lines.en: And the living witnesses will be handled carefully—protected properly by the department, right?
lines.style: Gentle push forward. Slower on the key word—'protected.' Not accusatory, but checking. Small pause before the final clause, like wanting confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場写真のディテールも詳細に検証されますね
lines.en: We're also examining the scene photographs in detail—every detail counts in verification.
lines.style: Assured, factual. Slight emphasis on 'detail.' Steady pacing. The tone of someone who has learned that thoroughness prevents oversights. Grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の恐怖症の症状を、警察、医師と確認されますね
lines.en: The victim's phobia symptoms will be cross-checked with a medical professional, as I understand it.
lines.style: Quiet precision. Slight lift on 'medical'—acknowledging expertise outside his scope. Thoughtful pause between the clinical detail and the confirmation. Respectful of complexity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、自殺現場の遺書の真贋鑑定もされますね
lines.en: We'll also authenticate the suicide note found at the scene—verify its authenticity.
lines.style: Controlled, clinical. No apologetic softening. Direct statement of what must be done. The tone of someone who doesn't flinch from difficult procedural facts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、裁判所の判決言い渡しに、警察、立ち会われますね
lines.en: The department will be present for the court's sentencing announcement, of course.
lines.style: Formal, official register. Slight finality on the last word. The rhythm of closing out a thread. Respectful gravity without heaviness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査と関係ない私事の情報は厳重に管理されますね
lines.en: And any information unrelated to the investigation—personal details—those are kept under strict confidentiality.
lines.style: Careful, protective. Emphasis on 'strict.' Lower, firmer tone. The word of someone who understands the weight of sensitive information. Small pause after the dash—no ambiguity.
